note: Deterministic obligations a Legion release must close, in gate order. Each obligation names the gate that owns it and the evidence that closes it. A verifier computes state transitions from these receipts; no model or reviewer may assert an obligation closed.

obligations.requirement: dispatch is first-attempt on refs/heads/main with an exact 40-character lowercase SHA that resolves and is an ancestor of origin/main
every ci.yml run for the exact SHA is completed and at least one concluded success, with no failed run
dispatched version equals release/version.json and no tag or release exists for it, drafts included
publish=true requires signed_qualification=true
one bootstrap object key across contract, policy and channels; stable HTTPS URL projects onto it; shared downloads bucket; no retired GitHub Pages path present
no drift in schemas, skill catalog, host projection, skill manifests, manifest, catalogs or plugin parity
pnpm-lock.yaml resolves the declared dependency set with no drift
hosted workflow files exactly match the lanes declared by .rightgit.json
no unclassified developer workspace, home or username value in tracked source
one candidate per build-input identity, platform and architecture, bound to run id, run attempt, version and source revision
candidate bytes are preserved and reused downstream without recompilation
every shipped Windows binary carries a Valid Authenticode signature with a timestamp, bound to the exact candidate digest
the macOS artifact is signed, notarized and stapled, bound to the exact candidate digest
install, launch, repair, status, doctor and uninstall succeed against the installed stable-current path under an isolated LOCALAPPDATA and USERPROFILE
the qualified executable resolves through the installed current pointer and never through a repository, dist, target or node_modules path
a failed qualification writes qualification-failure.json with failing stage, per-command exit codes and stream digests, and a link-aware install-tree inventory, before any cleanup
every required stage carries a SUCCEEDED finalize stage-summary bound to this exact version, source revision, run id and run attempt
uploaded GitHub asset digests equal the qualified signed artifact digests
the promoted R2 stable object reads back byte-identical to the versioned object it was promoted from
the public Worker route serves bytes identical to the R2 stable object
obligations.gap: no producer verifies deployed Worker bytes against the R2 stable object; Gate 7 readback is not yet automated

obligations.requirement: plain HTTP upgrades to HTTPS and every HTTPS response carries HSTS
obligations.gap: enforced by RightKit branded-installs worker tests, outside this repository; no Legion-side producer binds it to a release

obligations.requirement: the promotion path compiles nothing
